_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Wording for the run, boons and haul screens, written for UI (strings), Game Design (boon names and plain 'gives' lines) and the beats (the hero's and rival's reactions). The numbers in a 'gives' line are {n} placeholders read from the plan's data; {form} is the form's name on the player's branch. A temptation's card shows only a line from `temptation_lines`, never what it brings. Reactions follow the voice bibles (4 to 12 words). Claude-written; not marked by Orb.
